name: ironhaven-coastal-creature-surfaces
prompt: Create a production diffuse/albedo MATERIAL TEXTURE ATLAS for the five coastal creatures in the attached Ironhaven design reference. This is an actual source texture for 3D models in the game, NOT a concept illustration, NOT a showcase, NOT new characters. Square 2048 by 2048 image divided into precisely FOUR EQUAL square quadrants, no margins, no borders, no text, no labels, no layout shadows. Each quadrant is a seamless flat close-up surface filling its entire area, evenly illuminated and physically detailed, no obvious directional light, no object silhouettes. TOP LEFT: the dark weathered brown crustacean carapace from the reference crabs: intricate chitin grain, mottled ochre and burnt umber, fine cracks, subtle salt wear, irregular tiny calcified deposits, small algae stains, believable wet shell surface. TOP RIGHT: pale grey-green marine skin from the fog spitter and drowned: natural dense skin wrinkles of varying size, thin folds, fine pores, restrained purple-grey bruising and darker grey mottling, subtle veins, no gore, no eyes, no mouths, no distinct body parts. BOTTOM LEFT: deep desaturated navy and charcoal fisherman's oilskin fabric from the drowned coat: fine woven fabric structure, abrasion, salt stains, uneven faded waterproof coating, tiny scratches and restrained algae deposits, no buttons, no large seams, no garments, a continuous flat fabric texture. BOTTOM RIGHT: ancient marine bone and thick limb chitin from the abyss walker: aged grey-beige ridged surface, intricate pits, salt crust and mottled dark olive-brown discoloration, fine cracks and occasional tiny barnacle scarring, continuous organic surface. The textures must retain the highly realistic, detailed, damp and weathered style of the reference, high frequency surface detail mixed with natural larger variations. Avoid cartoon shapes, broad smooth toy surfaces, stylization, pixel art, bright clean colors, painted highlights, large raised barnacle clusters, repeated stamped patterns, gloss reflections baked into the image. The exact quadrant division matters for shader UV addressing.
usage: Runtime albedo and derivative bump atlas; quadrants are shell, marine skin, oilskin fabric, and bone/chitin. No external model or texture bytes.
license: Project-generated artwork under the existing image-generation service terms.
